messages:
jen: FYI — we have a high-priority ticket from a customer: their per-model throughput charts in Console show a flat 0 QPS starting ~03:00 UTC. They say requests are succeeding and app latency is normal. Ticket #3249.
kevin: Do we know if other dashboard panels are affected or only the per-model qps? Any alerts firing?
jen: Only the per-model throughput panel and the model-specific QPS alert. Global QPS (all models) looks fine. No infra alerts. Customer provided a screenshot of the blank per-model lines.
liam: Can you grab the metrics from the exporter/prometheus endpoint from that cluster? Example: `curl -s http://metrics.internal:9100/metrics | grep redwood` — share a sample.
jen: Pasting sanitized snippet from prometheus scrape (customer's prod):
```
# HELP redwood_inference_requests_total Total inference requests handled
# TYPE redwood_inference_requests_total counter
redwood_inference_requests_total{model_id="llama-13b",variant="v2",region="us-west-2",instance="i-012"} 123456
redwood_inference_requests_total{model_id="gptj-6b",variant="default",region="us-west-2",instance="i-013"} 98765
```
jen: Note: the metric exists but the label previously used by dashboards was `model` not `model_id`.
ana: (observability) Are dashboard queries written with `by (model)`? If so, they'll return empty series when `model` label is missing.
kevin: Confirmed — dashboards use `sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[5m])) by (model)` and the alert is `for: sum(rate(...)) by (model) < 1` — that will break when `model` doesn't exist.
liam: This started after a change to the runtime exporter which normalized labels to `model_id` and `variant` to reduce ambiguity between name and id. We forgot to emit a compatibility label `model`. My bad — that rollout went ~02:50 UTC.
jen: Customer impact timeline matches. They started noticing ~03:00 UTC.
kevin: Short-term mitigation: we can either (A) update Grafana queries to use `model_id` OR (B) add a Prometheus recording rule that copies `model_id` into `model` so dashboards keep working.
ana: Proposed quick fix (PromQL):
```
# recording rule example
- record: redwood_inference_requests_total:by_model
  expr: sum by (model_id, variant) (rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[5m]))
```
nana: Or use `label_replace` in the dashboard query to create a `model` label on the fly:
```
label_replace(sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[5m])), "model", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)")
```
kevin: Li am — can we roll a tiny exporter patch that emits `model` as alias for now, and cut a hotfix? That would be safest for users.
liam: I can cut a 1-line fix to add `model` label (copying `model_id`) and redeploy to hosted clusters. Will target a canary in prod in 15m.
deploy-bot: deploy started: liam/exporter-add-model-label -> cluster-prod-canary @ 1813457200
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: canary @ 1813457350
liam: Canary looks good. Metrics now show both labels:
```
redwood_inference_requests_total{model_id="llama-13b",model="llama-13b",variant="v2",...} 124000
```
liam: Rolling to remaining regions now.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: rollout completed @ 1813457488
kevin: After rollout, dashboards should pick up series again. Ana, can you validate dashboards and close the support ticket if all good?
ana: Checked Console and Grafana: per-model lines returned; the alert cleared after the new series appeared. I'll keep the recording rule suggestion on standby and add a 48-hour recording rule if we want an extra safety net.
jen: Customer notified that we're rolling a fix and graphs are back. They confirmed their team sees lines again.
liam: Postmortem action items: 1) Add backward-compatible label emission in exporter tests, 2) Add automation to detect label name drift in CI, 3) Publish rollout note about label renames. I'll own 1 and 3. ETA EOD.
kevin: I'll own 2 and add a Grafana compatibility check to the infra alerts board. ETA 2 days.
jen: Support to follow up & tick off ticket once we have the postmortem linked.
monitor-bot: Incident closed (auto) — per-model QPS recovered @ 1813457505 :white_check_mark:
